title: Daylight basement house with an attached garage
source: Plan set: existing basement and main floor plans and the proposed basement plan (1/4 inch = 1 foot).

fieldRoof.note: Not drawn: no roof plan or elevations in the set. Assumed hipped roof at 4:12 with 18 inch overhangs over the traced walls; house and garage share one plate height.

stages.label: House
stages.line: The house on its sloping lot: a one-story main floor and an attached garage over a finished daylight basement that opens to a wide deck on the low side. Choose Explore to turn the model or go to a room.

stages.label: Street side
stages.line: The street side: the garage door and the recessed entry porch with its double doors, with the main floor just above the ground. The basement is below grade on this side.

stages.label: Roof
stages.line: The roof lifts away. The plan set has no roof plan or elevations, so a 4:12 hipped roof with 18 inch overhangs is shown over the traced walls.

stages.label: Main floor
stages.line: The main floor: a galley kitchen, the living room with a long fireplace and a wall of windows to the deck, the laundry by the garage, the entry, two bedrooms, two baths and the primary bedroom with a walk-in closet.

stages.label: Basement
stages.line: The finished daylight basement: a living room with a second fireplace and a sliding door to the lower deck, an office, a bedroom, a large shop with its own outside door and the remodeled bath with a tub and shower.

stages.label: Slab
stages.line: The basement slab at the foot of the slope, with the lower deck on the open side and the ground rising to the garage and the street.

sheetLabel: Static plan of the main floor of a daylight basement house with an attached garage.
